fees.notes: Official UIS international fee for Ijazah Sarjana Muda Pengajian Islam (Bahasa Arab dengan Multimedia) (Bachelor of Islamic Studies (Arabic Language with Multimedia) (Hons)) (programme code bi06), last published on study.uis.edu.my (capture 20240722192944): RM51,034 total, an all-inclusive package covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D, full-time only) and graduation. UIS's current programme page (https://study.uis.edu.my/bi06, accessed 2026-09-18) says tuition fee information will be updated soon, so this is the latest officially published international figure. fees.per_year = total / official duration. Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20240722192944/https://study.uis.edu.my/bi06.
